Best Mini Split Specialists in Colorado

Mini split systems are highly sophisticated pieces of equipment that require specialized knowledge. In Colorado, Mini Split Local Pros is the recognized authority on ductless technology. Whether you need a simple annual cleaning of your blower wheel and filters, or a complex multi-zone installation for a historic home without ductwork, we have the experience to execute it flawlessly.

We are committed to helping you maximize your energy savings and system lifespan. Our comprehensive preventative maintenance plans keep your indoor units mold-free and your outdoor condenser operating at maximum efficiency, saving you money on utility bills and preventing costly future breakdowns.
